description: Hurricane Isaias crashed into the U.S. Gulf Coast as a dangerous Category 2 storm on Friday, lashing communities with wind and rain and threatening to flood low-lying areas where residents were advised to evacuate ahead of its arrival.
title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on U.S. Gulf Coast as Category 2 storm

description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on Friday, damaging buildings and sending thousands into the streets, but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths.
title: Powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake rocks Panama

author: Jesmeen Gill
description: Researchers at the University of Alberta have made a “jaw-dropping discovery” that a raptor dinosaur may have dined on a much larger tyrannosaur.
title: Fossil researchers believe dog-sized raptor may have fed on larger tyrannosaur

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: DonnaJean Wilde, a grandmother of 12, broke her own Guinness World Record for holding the longest female abdominal plank during the Huntsman World Senior Games in Utah this week.
title: Alberta woman, 61, breaks her own world record by planking for 5 hours

description: U.S. President Donald Trump said that he has struck a deal to obtain diesel from Russia, a stunning reversal after years of U.S. pressure on Moscow over its war with Ukraine and an attempt to address high fuel prices ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.
title: Trump announces diesel deal with Russia after conversation with Putin

author: Ian Froese
description: Manitoba's premier wants the province's schools to teach students about the intense public backlash to the expansion of francophone rights in the 1980s.
title: After days of giving French-only answers in legislature, Kinew wants schools to cover '80s language battle

description: U.S. Vice President JD Vance said on Friday he does not know whether the Pentagon will carry out its plan to livestream the execution by firing squad of the former U.S. Army psychiatrist convicted in the deadly 2009 Fort Hood shooting, a plan that has drawn broad condemnation.
title: Vance unsure if Pentagon will livestream a prisoner's execution, but he won't be watching

author: Nicole Brockbank
description: An investor and friend of Aiden Pleterski showed up at the lakefront mansion of the self-described "Crypto King" in June 2022 to "get proof in person" of how much money was in Pleterski’s investment account. Pleterski has pleaded not guilty to fraud over $5,000 and money laundering.
title: 'Crypto King' investor recounts the moment he learned $311M investment fund didn’t exist

description: The axe-wielding co-pilot who attacked the captain of a FlyDubai flight to Tel Aviv last month intended to seize control of the airplane and fly it into the passenger terminal at Israel's main international airport, authorities in the United Arab Emirates said Friday.
title: FlyDubai co-pilot sought to crash plane into Tel Aviv's main airport: UAE

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: HBO will continues the Crazy Rich Asians story as an eight-episode series, with stars Constance Wu, Henry Golding and Michelle Yeoh returning.
title: Crazy Rich Asians to get the TV treatment with original stars on HBO

author: Padraig Moran
description: Newfoundlander Paul Matthews picked up the phone last month, not knowing it was Jax Irwin on the other end. Irwin cold calls people on the east coast, just to chat. But that day, she had Hollywood star Josh Hartnett and the cast of a new Netflix show on the line with her.
title: A Newfoundlander got a random call from a bunch of Hollywood stars — and just went with it

description: Police and young protesters clashed in Brussels on Friday, as tens of thousands of people rallied in the Belgian capital against rising living costs and budget-tightening measures introduced by the government.
title: IN PHOTOS | Belgium youths, police clash during protests

author: Peter Zimonjic
description: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre dismissed tech billionaire Elon Musk's calls this week for multiple provinces to separate from Canada, saying "Canadians control their own destiny."
title: Poilievre shrugs off Musk's pro-separatist posts: 'Canadians control their own destiny'

author: Darren Bernhardt
description: Residential school denialism is detestable but not illegal, and that shouldn't change, says Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew, who disagrees with federal Manitoba NDPer Leah Gazan's efforts to add it to the Criminal Code.
title: Residential school denialism shouldn't be illegal, Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Turn and face the strange: ch-ch-changes could be coming to your living room wall. A rare signed David Bowie self-portrait is up for auction and it's even got his handprints — though it'll cost you a pretty penny.
title: This rare David Bowie self-portrait is going up for auction

description: The Trump administration imposed sweeping new sanctions Friday on the International Criminal Court, which it says is politicized and attempting to illegally prosecute Americans and Israelis. The court denounced the U.S. move as "an assault on the rule of law" aiming to prevent its work.
title: Trump administration hits International Criminal Court with sweeping sanctions

author: Jim Litke
description: Famed NFL head coach Mike Ditka has died at the age of 86, his family announced on Friday.
title: Famed NFL coach Mike Ditka dead at 86

description: The ruling comes in the case of a Mi'kmaw man with severe mental health challenges who was sentenced in Nova Scotia to five years in prison after pleading guilty to aggravated assault against his partner, a Mi'kmaw woman.
title: Top court sets sentencing framework for cases involving Indigenous offenders, victims

description: For about nine decades, executions in the U.S. have been private affairs, often shrouded in secrecy. If carried out as planned, death penalty experts said it would mark the first known broadcast or livestream of a lawful execution.
title: The U.S. plans to livestream an execution. Here's how that compares to global practice

author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours
description: A Miami International Airport official says Avianca Airlines Flight 042, travelling from Medellin, Colombia, to New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport, was diverted "due to turbulence."
title: 8 people hospitalized after turbulence forces Medellin-New York flight to divert to Miami

author: Associated Press
description: A Darth Vader lightsaber used in the climactic duel in Cloud City, where the villain tells Luke Skywalker "I am your father," is among the highlights of the Ultimate Star Wars Auction to be held by Heritage Auctions on Nov. 12.
title: Darth Vader's lightsaber is up for auction

description: A U.S. judge has ordered the Trump administration to facilitate the release and return of an Egyptian man who was deported to Equatorial Guinea this year and has since ‌been jailed there.
title: Judge orders U.S. government to return Arizona man deported to Equatorial Guinea
‘Not as long as I’m premier’: Danielle Smith rules out 2nd separation referendum if Albertans vote to remain
ICE shooting of New York man in car with 5-year-old sparks protests, anger from mayor

author: Ian Urbina
description: Much of the fish meal and fish oil that support farmed salmon and imported seafood consumed in Canada come from global supply chains linked to pollution, labour abuses, overfishing, and food insecurity in poorer countries.
title: What is your seafood eating? Investigation traces problems in global feed supply

description: The decline marks a second straight month of job losses. Economists polled ahead of the release predicted employers added 9,200 positions in September.
title: Canadian economy lost 68,000 jobs in September

description: An airline pilot was among three Saudi citizens killed in attacks targeting Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, the kingdom's civil aviation authority said on Friday.
title: 3 people killed in Houthi attack on main airport in Riyadh, Saudi officials say

description: Two Renoir paintings stolen from a museum in southern France last month have been found, and six people arrested, local authorities say.
title: Renoir paintings recovered, 6 people arrested after heist at France museum last month

description: Hurricane Simon was headed toward part of Mexico's Pacific Coast on Friday and forecast to get much stronger, leading to hurricane-force winds and torrential rains that could cause flooding and mudslides.
title: Hurricane Simon forecast to get much stronger as it heads to Mexico's Pacific Coast

description: The Norwegian Nobel Committee is announcing the 2026 peace prize winner.
title: Nobel Peace Prize winner announced

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Run Terry Run, a new documentary directed by Sean Menard, offers a deeper look at Terry Fox beyond his status as one of Canada’s most celebrated heroes. The film draws from 96 reels of previously unseen footage from Fox's 1980 Marathon of Hope, and highlights his humour, frustrations and determination to inspire Canadians to support cancer research.
title: 11 things we learned about Terry Fox from Run Terry Run

author: Abby Hughes
description: Canada has long relied on its allies to get technologies like satellites into space. But as the cross-border relationship with the U.S. changes, a handful of companies — including the newest player, Canada Rocket Company — are trying to change that and capitalize on a growing market.
title: Canada can't launch rockets on its own. A handful of companies want to change that

author: Jackson Weaver
description: Though Aaron Sorkin's The Social Reckoning positions itself as endlessly relevant, it's so vapid and made with such disinterest that it resists serious hatred. The follow-up to 2010's Facebook-takedown The Social Network is an insulting bore with very little insight or opinion to disagree with, let alone productively hate.
title: The Social Reckoning is not only not as good as The Social Network, it's also not good enough to hate

author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours
description: Experts say the WNBA could play more games in larger venues as it surges in popularity, thanks to the rise of star players, new teams and a wave of interest in women's sports more broadly.
title: The WNBA set an attendance record. What new heights can the league reach?

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Halle Berry is denying allegations made by her ex-husband Olivier Martinez, who has filed for sole custody and a restraining order, accusing her of physically abusing their 13-year-old son, Maceo. Her 18-year-old daughter has come to her defence.
title: Halle Berry is denying child abuse claims by her ex-husband. Here's what we know
